idea-plugin.name: Tarn Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Tarn is a dark theme inspired by the stillness of a high-altitude glacial lake — deep navy depths, steel blue shimmers, and teal-to-azure syntax highlighting.

Installing this plugin adds both the Tarn UI theme (tool windows, tabs, dialogs, toolbars) and the matching Tarn editor color scheme. Select it under Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme.

Ports for VS Code, Neovim, Zed, Helix, Alacritty, WezTerm, iTerm2, Windows Terminal and Zellij live in the same repository: harehare/tarn-theme.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0 — Initial release: Tarn UI theme plus the bundled Tarn editor color scheme.
